ui.title: Stars Quiz
ui.p: Scratch-offs, a star store, a family goal… Rate each idea 1 to 10. 10 = love it! Tap 🤔 Other to say how you'd do it.
ui.other: Instead of "%s", how would you do it? Say it or type it.

about: Rewards that are a little unpredictable (a scratch-off, a mystery prize) keep kids going longer than the same prize every time. That's why games like McDonald's Monopoly work: every piece is an instant chance, plus you collect sets for bigger prizes, and one piece in each set is super rare.

The #1 complaint from Skylight owners and parents online: kids love the chart for a few weeks or months, then stop caring. What helps: kids pick their own prizes, prizes change every so often, and there's a bonus-jobs board. So this quiz has seasons, sets and kid-picked prizes.
Families who fill a jar together toward a trip or a big outing say it makes the kids cheer each other on instead of competing. Some home-hub builders pool everyone's stars into a family jackpot.
A common Skylight complaint is that a kid taps the chore and gets the stars with nobody checking. Home Assistant chore systems add a parent okay for big chores and for spending stars.

Child-screen experts warn that making screens the top prize makes kids want them more. Ideas: charge more for games than shows, cap how much you can buy a week, and keep plenty of prizes that aren't screens.
Rate each card 1 to 10 (10 = love it, 1 = no way), or tap 🤔 Other and say what you'd do instead. Parents also rate the kids' cards. Got an idea? Tap 🎤.

ideas.title: A star store
ideas.desc: Save up stars and trade them for prizes: screen time, a Starbucks trip, staying up late, and more.

ideas.title: Scratch-off right away
ideas.desc: Finish chores and you get a scratch-off card on the screen. Scratch it with your finger to see what you won.

ideas.title: Monopoly-style collecting
ideas.desc: Like McDonald's Monopoly: some scratch-offs give a game piece. Collect a whole set to win that set's big prize.

ideas.title: A family goal we all earn together
ideas.desc: Everyone's stars fill one big family jar toward something we do together, like a waterpark hotel weekend.

ideas.title: Stars turn into allowance
ideas.desc: Every Sunday your stars turn into real money (like 10¢ a star) that you can save or spend.

ideas.title: Small chores are just expected
ideas.desc: Making your bed or clearing your plate earns no stars because that's part of being in the family. Stars are for bigger or extra jobs.

ideas.title: Bigger chores earn more stars
ideas.desc: Quick jobs = 1 star, medium = 2, big jobs like cleaning the bathroom = 3 or more.

ideas.title: Keep it simple: every chore = 1 star
ideas.desc: No math. Each check-off is one star.

ideas.title: A scratch-off after every chore
ideas.desc: Lots of little surprises, all day long.

ideas.title: A scratch-off only when the whole day is done
ideas.desc: Fewer scratch-offs, but they feel special, and you have to finish everything to get one.

ideas.title: What's under it: mostly stars, sometimes more
ideas.desc: Most say +1 or +2 stars, some say +5, and a few win a real prize right away.

ideas.title: Rare golden ticket
ideas.desc: About 1 in 50 scratch-offs is golden: a Starbucks trip, skip-a-chore pass, or pick tonight's dinner.

ideas.title: Instant prizes you get today
ideas.desc: Like a treat from the snack drawer, 15 minutes of screen time, or front seat today.

ideas.title: Some say "Try again"
ideas.desc: Like a real scratch-off, not every card wins. That makes the wins more exciting.

ideas.title: Scratch with your finger, with sparkles and sounds
ideas.desc: On the big screen it feels like a real scratch-off: silver foil, sparkles, a drumroll, a cheer.

ideas.title: Scratch on your iPhone too
ideas.desc: Your scratch-offs wait for you and you can scratch them on any screen.

ideas.title: Collect sets for big prizes
ideas.desc: Example sets: ☕ Starbucks (3 pieces), 🍿 Movie night (3), 🎢 Fun outing (4), 🏨 Hotel night (4).

ideas.title: One piece in each set is super rare
ideas.desc: Like Boardwalk in Monopoly: you'll get most pieces fast, but the last one is hard to find.

ideas.title: Rare pieces are guaranteed eventually
ideas.desc: If you've done 30 scratch-offs without your rare piece, the next one has it. Bad luck can't last forever.

ideas.title: Trade pieces with your sibling
ideas.desc: Got two of something? Trade with Nellie or Nash for the piece you need.

ideas.title: Your own game board on the hub
ideas.desc: A board with your colors shows which pieces you've collected and what's left.

ideas.title: A new game every season
ideas.desc: New sets and prizes for football season, Christmas, spring and summer, so it never gets old.

ideas.title: Mom & Dad can hand out a bonus scratch-off
ideas.desc: For being kind or helpful, or a great game, without any chore.

ideas.title: Screen time
ideas.desc: 30 minutes = 3 stars, 1 hour = 5 stars.

ideas.title: Games cost more than shows
ideas.desc: Video games cost more stars than a show or a movie.

ideas.title: Weekly cap on screen time you can buy
ideas.desc: Like 3 hours a week, so screens don't become the only prize.

ideas.title: Starbucks trip
ideas.desc: A drink and a treat with Mom or Dad.

ideas.title: Stay up 30 minutes late
ideas.desc: 8 stars now.

ideas.title: Pick what's for dinner
ideas.desc: 10 stars now.

ideas.title: Ice cream trip
ideas.desc: 15 stars now.

ideas.title: Trade stars for cash
ideas.desc: Like $10 for 40 stars.

ideas.title: Pick the family movie
ideas.desc: You choose Friday movie night.

ideas.title: Front seat and car music for a week
ideas.desc: You ride up front and pick the music.

ideas.title: Skip-a-chore pass
ideas.desc: Skip one chore, once.

ideas.title: Friend over or a sleepover
ideas.desc: A big prize to save up for.

ideas.title: One-on-one time with Mom or Dad
ideas.desc: Lunch out, a treat run, or something just you two pick.

ideas.title: Sports gear
ideas.desc: New shoes, a ball, or training gear. Parents pay part, stars pay the rest.

ideas.title: Fun outing
ideas.desc: Mall of America, a trampoline park, the movies.

ideas.title: You add wishes, Mom & Dad set the price
ideas.desc: Put anything you want in the store and a parent decides how many stars it costs.

ideas.title: New store items every month
ideas.desc: Fresh prizes so there's always something new to save for.

ideas.title: Big family goal: a waterpark hotel weekend
ideas.desc: One big goal we fill up over a few months, then we all go.

ideas.title: Small family goals every month
ideas.desc: Like pizza + movie night or a bowling night when the jar fills.

ideas.title: The family votes on the next goal
ideas.desc: Everyone suggests goals and we vote on the hub.

ideas.title: A big progress bar on the home screen
ideas.desc: Everyone can see how close we are every time we walk by.

ideas.title: Every star counts twice
ideas.desc: Each star you earn goes in your own store AND fills the family jar. Spending doesn't take it out of the jar.

ideas.title: You choose: spend on yourself or give to the family goal
ideas.desc: Put some of your stars into the family jar when you want to.

ideas.title: Mom & Dad's chores fill the family jar too
ideas.desc: The parents earn stars for the family goal (not for the store).

ideas.title: Real money into a vacation fund
ideas.desc: Each family star puts a little real money (like 10¢) into a trip fund that we'd spend anyway.

ideas.title: +2 bonus stars when the whole day is done
ideas.desc: Finish every chore for the day and you get 2 extra stars.

ideas.title: Streaks for days in a row
ideas.desc: The hub counts how many days in a row you finished everything.

ideas.title: Streak prizes
ideas.desc: 7 days in a row = a bonus scratch-off, 30 days = a golden ticket.

ideas.title: Levels: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond
ideas.desc: Your lifetime stars move you up levels (like a video game). Spending never takes your level away.

ideas.title: Weekly sibling race
ideas.desc: Whoever earns more stars this week wins a small prize.

ideas.title: Lose a star for a skipped chore
ideas.desc: If it's not done by bedtime, you lose a star.

ideas.title: Mom or Dad okays big chores before stars count
ideas.desc: Quick chores count right away. For big jobs, a parent gives a thumbs up first.

ideas.title: Approve store purchases from our iPhones
ideas.desc: When a kid buys something, we get a tap-to-approve on our phones.

ideas.title: Monthly budget for prizes that cost money
ideas.desc: Starbucks, outings and gear come out of a set monthly amount, so the prize odds stay affordable.

ideas.title: We set the scratch-off odds and prizes
ideas.desc: A Mom & Dad screen to change what's under the scratch-offs and how often.

ideas.title: Squishies and skincare in my store
ideas.desc: Spend stars on a new squishy or a skincare product. Maybe a Sephora set!

ideas.title: Fishing gear and a fishing trip
ideas.desc: New lures in the store, and a fishing trip as a set prize.

ideas.title: Coach awards: MVP of the week
ideas.desc: Sunday night the hub names an MVP with a bonus golden ticket.

ideas.title: A classroom-style marble jar
ideas.desc: Like a 4th-grade class: the family jar fills with marbles on screen for teamwork and kindness, not just chores.
